LanguageData.TM_BladeServiceHint: Hit enemies with Passage or service different damaged weapons to learn {0}. Place a weapon on the ground. Service restores 10% durability. Damage caused by your faction does not count.
LanguageData.TM_BladeMasteryHint: To learn {0}, land eight damaging melee counterattacks within four seconds of the attacker's hit, or personally carry twelve wounded, downed allies to a bed. The same casualty can count again after one day.
